children: Tesla and SpaceX formed board committees to explore a possible combination, but no deal has been agreed. A merger may be discussed at Tesla’s Dec. 3 annual shareholder meeting.
Tesla shares fell over 3% Friday amid merger speculation. HSBC upgraded TSLA to Hold from Reduce and raised its target to $359, citing limited near-term synergies and regulatory risks.
Tesla (TSLA) won provisional Italian approval for its Level 2 Assisted Driving system, the first major EU country to do so. It will launch via software update at €99 monthly; drivers must stay alert.
Tesla, Inc. (TSLA) launched Cybercab robotaxi operations in Dallas, its second U.S. city for the service after Austin. The fleet in Dallas previously used Model Y vehicles.
Tesla (TSLA) posted positive free cash flow in the first nine months of 2026, while SpaceX had deep cash outflows. Analysts questioned funding needs and dilution under a proposed all-stock merger.
Tesla, Inc. (TSLA) reportedly plans to invest €3 billion in its German plant and build a Cybercab production facility there, with a reported target capacity of one million units.
A potential Tesla merger could face national-security and political scrutiny, as Tesla has major China operations and SpaceX serves U.S. military and intelligence agencies.
Tesla (TSLA) proposed a $3.1 billion Texas polysilicon plant and sought state tax incentives, citing them as key to site selection. It plans to open in 2030 and employ 515 workers by 2032.
Tesla opened its first Argentina store in Buenos Aires and began taking orders for Model 3 and Model Y, priced at about $40,000 to $50,000.
Tesla CEO Elon Musk called the Cybercab’s $299 monthly fee too high, saying it should be closer to $115, in line with FSD and connectivity costs on other Tesla models. No change timeline was given.
